messages:
emma: Quick FYI — opened a PR to consolidate our rate-plan examples and the SDK migration snippets. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/842
raj: Nice. Do we also need to update the quota headers example in the python snippet? I noticed the old `X-Quota-Tier` key is still used.
maria: I saw that too. Also the grafana panel link in the billing dashboard example is 404 — the panel id changed after the dashboard rename.
emma: OK, I'll update the python snippet to use `client.create_usage_report(..., billing_header=\"x-redwood-quota\")` and swap the header name in the examples.
raj: Can you add a tiny code sample for sdkv5 backwards-compat? Something like:

```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.usage.list(limit=10, headers={"x-redwood-quota": "tier-A"})
print(resp[0])
```

That'll help with migrations.
sree: Also add a short note about burst credits — our meter aggregates can temporarily show lower per-token cost during bursts which confused a customer last week. A single sentence in the rate limits doc should be enough.
emma: Good call @sree — I'll add an FAQ bullet: "Why might my dashboard show sudden dips?" with a brief explanation of burst credit smoothing.
maria: I'll patch the grafana URL in a follow-up commit (small rename). After that we should run link-checker and the l10n pass.
emma: @docs-bot can you run the link check for this branch? :mag:
docs-bot: Link check queued. Results: 1 failing link (grafana panel) — failing URL https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/old-dashboard/1100. See CI job: https://ci.redwood.ai/links/3098
emma: I updated the PR with the header rename, the sdkv5 snippet, and the burst note. PTAL. If all green I'll merge tomorrow EOD unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:
raj: LGTM from my side — thanks for taking this on.
maria: LGTM, will follow up with the grafana URL PR in ~30m.
sree: looks fine, thanks!
